key: You're not going any further. Orders are orders, and they come from the top dog.
en: You're not going any further. Orders are orders, and they come from the top dog.
ja: ここから先は　行かせない。命令は命令だ　しかも　いちばん上からのな

key: Defeat is defeat.
en: Defeat is defeat.
ja: 負けは　負けだ

key: There are some things that just can't be changed.
en: There are some things that just can't be changed.
ja: 変えられないことも　あるんだよ

key: The students are all in a fluster. I need a distraction.
en: The students are all in a fluster. I need a distraction.
ja: 生徒たちは　みんな　浮足立っている。気をそらすものが　必要だ

key: You're a flurry yourself.
en: You're a flurry yourself.
ja: きみこそ　ひと嵐　だったよ

key: All right now, everyone stay calm.
en: All right now, everyone stay calm.
ja: さあ　みんな　落ち着いて

key: Hey, sly. Don't move.
en: Hey, sly. Don't move.
ja: おい　こそこそ屋。動くな

key: Do you even go here?
en: Do you even go here?
ja: そもそも　うちの生徒か?

key: Whatever, I tried.
en: Whatever, I tried.
ja: まあいい　やるだけは　やった

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: カギが　かかっている

key: You're a Gym challenger, aren't you?
en: You're a Gym challenger, aren't you?
ja: ジムの挑戦者　だよね?

key: Visitors are frequent here, but they usually don't have to come upstairs.
en: Visitors are frequent here, but they usually don't have to come upstairs.
ja: ここは　来客が多いけど　ふつうは　上の階まで　来ないよ

key: Are you lost?
en: Are you lost?
ja: 道に　迷った?

key: Are you a Gym challenger here?
en: Are you a Gym challenger here?
ja: ここの　ジム挑戦者　なの?

key: Oh, you won a long time ago? Well then.
en: Oh, you won a long time ago? Well then.
ja: えっ　ずっと前に　勝ってたの? それなら　いいけど

key: Listen, I think you're really cool, and...
en: Listen, I think you're really cool, and...
ja: あのね　あなたって　すごく　かっこいいと　思ってて……

key: And I was just, uhm, wondering if you wanted to maybe...
en: And I was just, uhm, wondering if you wanted to maybe...
ja: それで　その……もしよかったら……

key: STUDENT: Hey!
en: STUDENT: Hey!
ja: 生徒: ちょっと!

key: STUDENT: D-don't sneak up on me like that!
en: STUDENT: D-don't sneak up on me like that!
ja: 生徒: そ　そんなふうに　急に　近づかないでよ!

key: TEACHER: Sorry about that.
en: TEACHER: Sorry about that.
ja: 先生: ごめんなさいね

key: I'll go get a janitor.
en: I'll go get a janitor.
ja: 用務員さんを　呼んでくるよ
